rules.description: ALLOW verified SEARCH bots (Googlebot/Bing) - nunca bloquear; SEO e IA nao entram

rules.expression: (http.request.full_uri contains "/wp-admin/" and http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "/wp-json/rankmath/" and http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.host contains "googlesyndication.com") or (http.host contains "doubleclick.net") or (http.host contains "googleadservices.com") or (http.host contains "pagead2.googlesyndication.com")

rules.description: [WP] Bloqueio de Ameaças Comuns + bots de SEO (Ahrefs/Semrush/etc)
rules.expression: (http.request.full_uri contains "author=" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "readme.html" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "license.txt" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains ".git" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "wp-config" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains ".bak" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "xmlrpc.php" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.user_agent contains "AhrefsBot") or (http.user_agent contains "SemrushBot") or (http.user_agent contains "RSiteAuditor") or (http.user_agent contains "MJ12bot") or (http.user_agent contains "DotBot") or (http.user_agent contains "DataForSeoBot") or (http.user_agent contains "BLEXBot") or (http.user_agent contains "PetalBot") or (http.user_agent contains "trendictionbot") or (http.user_agent contains "KeenableBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Amazonbot")

(http.request.full_uri contains "wp-login.php" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "xmlrpc.php" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_") or (http.request.full_uri contains "wp-admin/admin-ajax.php" and not http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in_")
(http.request.uri.path contains "/.env" or http.request.uri.path contains "/.git" or http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-config.php")
